searchText: A while ago I was tracing the tip of the chain for a week or two and found a handful of contracts still using CALLCODE (e.g. `0x3885b0c18E3C4aB0CA2B8DC99771944404687628`). I'll start the script again to see if there are more of them Is that just a callcode forwarder? hmm, it's got 250 ETH stuck inside it What happens to the code execution of these contracts if you just make CALLCODE have the same functionality as DELEGATECALL?
